## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The `--exclude` default should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment omit matching files.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by name and logs skips in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds parser, collection, and archive tests.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser uses `default=[]` and includes `app.log`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` requires each new flag to “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment can publish archives containing files they meant to omit.
